content.query:
SELECT TOP 2000 
    CustomerKey, 
    FirstName, 
    LastName
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'https://lakeylakey3.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Customer/*.parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) WITH (
    CustomerKey INT,
    FirstName VARCHAR(100) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8,
    LastName VARCHAR(100) COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8
) as query_test;
